title: Survivor, his Dog Meet their Coast Guard heroes
description: A 35-year-old man from Rome, Georgia, talks about being rescued and meets with the Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew that saved him, at Air Station Clearwater, Florida, Monday, July 13, 2015. The man and his dog, Evi, were rescued after his sailboat caught fire 69 miles west of Hudson, Florida, Friday, July 10. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Ashley J. Johnson
